summary: One record per vital sign measurement per time point per visit per subject. Transpose wide CRF data (one column per test) into one row per test.

VSPOS.tip: Position from the POSITION codelist, e.g. "SITTING", "SUPINE", if collected.

VSORRESU.tip: Units as collected, from the VSRESU / UNIT codelist, e.g. "mmHg", "beats/min", "C", "kg", "cm".

VSSTRESU.tip: One standard unit per test across the whole study, e.g. convert pounds to kg.

VSLOBXFL.tip: "Y" on each subject's last non-missing value per test before first dose (DM.RFXSTDTC).
